title: Your map is lying to you
sources: Contiguous United States 8,080,470 km²: Geography Realm, 'Continental vs. Contiguous United States'
China 9.6 million km², India 3,287,263 km² (official figure, Survey of India boundary in data/india-official.geojson)
Placements inside Africa: found by search in an equal-area projection; each shape is moved on the sphere, so its true size is kept

script.say: The map you grew up with has been lying to you.
Look at Greenland. It looks as big as Africa.
Now slide it down to the equator.
Same island, real size. Africa is fourteen times bigger.
Flat maps stretch everything near the poles.
So how big is Africa, really?
And there's still room to spare.
A globe never lies. Spin one yourself, on Bhoogol.
